c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = maxd[c];\n                if (d < threshold && d < best_d) {\n                    best_d = d;\n                    best_i = c;\n                }\n            }\n            s_dist[threadIdx.x] = best_d;\n            s_idx[threadIdx.x] = best_i;\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Block-level (distance, index) lexicographic min reduction\n            for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < off) {\n                    const double od = s_dist[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    const int oi = s_idx[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    if (oi >= 0 &&\n                        (s_idx[threadIdx.x] < 0 || od < s_dist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                         (od == s_dist[threadIdx.x] && oi < s_idx[threadIdx.x]))) {\n                        s_dist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        s_idx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_best = s_idx[0];\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const int best = s_best;\n            if (best < 0) break;  // No more points can be added\n            count++;\n\n            // Incrementally fold the new member into every candidate's maxd.\n            // maxd only grows, so a candidate that reaches the threshold can\n            // never be added again and is excluded permanently (DBL_MAX).\n            const Point bp = points[best];\n            for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n                const double cur = maxd[c];\n                if (c == best) {\n                    maxd[c] = DBL_MAX;\n                } else if (cur < DBL_MAX) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[c], bp);\n                    if (d > cur) maxd[c] = (d < threshold) ? d : DBL_MAX;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        cards[s] = count;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}","newString":"// One thread block grows one candidate cluster per seed (blocks stride over\n// the seed list). Every future member must lie within `threshold` of the\n// seed, so the block first compacts those neighbors into a candidate list\n// and then only ever touches that list. maxd[i] holds the maximum distance\n// from candidate cand[i] to all current cluster members; DBL_MAX marks\n// candidates that became unavailable (added to the cluster, or exceeded the\n// threshold — maxd only grows, so such a point can never be added later).\n// Each step adds the eligible candidate with the smallest maxd (ties broken\n// by the lowest point index), matching the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\nstatic const int KERNEL_BLOCK = 256;\n\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                       const int num_seeds,\n                                       const int N,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       double* __restrict__ maxd_pool,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cand_pool,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double s_dist[KERNEL_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[KERNEL_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_best;\n    __shared__ int s_count;\n\n    double* maxd = maxd_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* cand = cand_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n        // Compact the seed's threshold neighborhood into the candidate list\n        // (list order is arbitrary; selection ties break on the point index)\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_count = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (!clustered[c] && c != seed) {\n                const double d = distance(points[c], sp);\n                if (d < threshold) {\n                    const int slot = atomicAdd(&s_count, 1);\n                    cand[slot] = c;\n                    maxd[slot] = d;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int L = s_count;\n\n        int count = 1;\n        while (count < N) {\n            // Per-thread argmin over eligible candidates\n            double best_d = DBL_MAX;\n            int best_i = -1;\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < L; i += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = maxd[i];\n                if (d < threshold &&\n                    (d < best_d || (d == best_d && cand[i] < best_i))) {\n                    best_d = d;\n                    best_i = cand[i];\n                }\n            }\n            s_dist[threadIdx.x] = best_d;\n            s_idx[threadIdx.x] = best_i;\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Block-level (distance, index) lexicographic min reduction\n            for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < off) {\n                    const double od = s_dist[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    const int oi = s_idx[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    if (oi >= 0 &&\n                        (s_idx[threadIdx.x] < 0 || od < s_dist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                         (od == s_dist[threadIdx.x] && oi < s_idx[threadIdx.x]))) {\n                        s_dist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        s_idx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_best = s_idx[0];\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const int best = s_best;\n            if (best < 0) break;  // No more points can be added\n            count++;\n\n            // Incrementally fold the new member into every candidate's maxd\n            const Point bp = points[best];\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < L; i += blockDim.x) {\n                const double cur = maxd[i];\n                if (cur < DBL_MAX) {\n                    if (cand[i] == best) {\n                        maxd[i] = DBL_MAX;\n                    } else {\n                        const double d = distance(points[cand[i]], bp);\n                        if (d > cur) maxd[i] = (d < threshold) ? d : DBL_MAX;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        cards[s] = count;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}","originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization scheme:\n//  - MPI: the candidate seeds of each outer iteration are distributed\n//    cyclically across ranks; the globally best candidate cluster is\n//    selected with an Allreduce on an encoded (cardinality, seed) key.\n//  - CUDA: each rank grows all of its candidate clusters on the GPU with\n//    one thread block per seed. Per-candidate maximum distances to the\n//    growing cluster are maintained incrementally (O(N) per added member\n//    instead of O(N * |members|)), which is exactly equivalent since\n//    max() over the same set of distances is order independent.\n//  - OpenMP: threads drive multiple GPUs per rank concurrently, and\n//    parallelize the host-side re-growth of the winning cluster as well\n//    as the statistics/serialization loops.\n//\n// Floating point contraction is disabled on both host (-ffp-contract=off)\n// and device (-fmad=false) so CPU and GPU distance computations are\n// bitwise identical, preserving the sequential algorithm's semantics.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA candidate-cluster kernel\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// One thread block grows one candidate cluster per seed (blocks stride over\n// the seed list). maxd[c] holds the maximum distance from candidate c to all\n// current cluster members; DBL_MAX marks points that are unavailable\n// (already globally clustered, or already members of this cluster).\n// Each step adds the eligible candidate with the smallest maxd (ties broken\n// by the lowest point index), matching the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\nstatic const int KERNEL_BLOCK = 256;\n\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                       const int num_seeds,\n                                       const int N,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       double* __restrict__ maxd_pool,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double s_dist[KERNEL_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[KERNEL_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_best;\n\n    double* maxd = maxd_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n        // Initialize per-candidate max distance (distance to the seed)\n        for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            double d = DBL_MAX;\n            if (!clustered[c] && c != seed) {\n                d = distance(points[c], sp);\n                if (d >= threshold) d = DBL_MAX;\n            }\n            maxd[c] = d;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        int count = 1;\n        while (count < N) {\n            // Per-thread argmin over eligible candidates\n            double best_d = DBL_MAX;\n            int best_i = -1;\n            for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = maxd[c];\n                if (d < threshold && d < best_d) {\n                    best_d = d;\n                    best_i = c;\n                }\n            }\n            s_dist[threadIdx.x] = best_d;\n            s_idx[threadIdx.x] = best_i;\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Block-level (distance, index) lexicographic min reduction\n            for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < off) {\n                    const double od = s_dist[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    const int oi = s_idx[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    if (oi >= 0 &&\n                        (s_idx[threadIdx.x] < 0 || od < s_dist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                         (od == s_dist[threadIdx.x] && oi < s_idx[threadIdx.x]))) {\n                        s_dist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        s_idx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_best = s_idx[0];\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const int best = s_best;\n            if (best < 0) break;  // No more points can be added\n            count++;\n\n            // Incrementally fold the new member into every candidate's maxd.\n            // maxd only grows, so a candidate that reaches the threshold can\n            // never be added again and is excluded permanently (DBL_MAX).\n            const Point bp = points[best];\n            for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n                const double cur = maxd[c];\n                if (c == best) {\n                    maxd[c] = DBL_MAX;\n                } else if (cur < DBL_MAX) {\n                    const double d = distance(points[c], bp);\n                    if (d > cur) maxd[c] = (d < threshold) ? d : DBL_MAX;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        cards[s] = count;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Per-GPU device context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct GpuCtx {\n    int dev = -1;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    double* d_pool = nullptr;\n    int pool_blocks = 0;\n};\n\nstatic void initGpuCtx(GpuCtx& g, const int dev, const std::vector<Point>& points) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    g.dev = dev;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(dev));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_points, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(Point)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_points, points.data(),\n                          static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(Point),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_clustered, static_cast<size_t>(N)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_seeds, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_cards, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(int)));\n\n    // Size the scratch pool (one row of N doubles per resident block),\n    // capped at half of the currently free device memory.\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n    size_t cap = (free_mem / 2) / row;\n    if (cap < 1) cap = 1;\n    g.pool_blocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(1024, cap));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_pool, static_cast<size_t>(g.pool_blocks) * row));\n}\n\nstatic void freeGpuCtx(GpuCtx& g) {\n    if (g.dev < 0) return;\n    cudaSetDevice(g.dev);\n    cudaFree(g.d_points);\n    cudaFree(g.d_clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.d_cards);\n    cudaFree(g.d_pool);\n    g.dev = -1;\n}\n\n// Encode (cardinality, seed) so that MPI_MAX picks the highest cardinality,\n// with ties broken by the lowest seed index (matching the sequential scan\n// order over the ascending unclustered list).\nstatic inline long long encodeBest(const int card, const int seed) {\n    if (card < 0) return -1;\n    return (static_cast<long long>(card) << 31) |\n           static_cast<long long>(INT32_MAX - seed);\n}\n\nstatic inline int decodeSeed(const long long v) {\n    return INT32_MAX - static_cast<int>(v & 0x7FFFFFFFLL);\n}\n\n// Pick a host thread count proportional to the loop size; spawning the full\n// thread pool (e.g. 256 logical CPUs) for small arrays costs far more in\n// fork/join overhead than the loop itself.\nstatic inline int hostThreads(const int work) {\n    int t = work / 2048;\n    if (t < 1) t = 1;\n    const int m = omp_get_max_threads();\n    return t > m ? m : t;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host-side (OpenMP) re-growth of the winning candidate cluster.\n// Uses the same incremental max-distance scheme as the kernel and therefore\n// produces the identical member list, in the identical insertion order.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                            const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                            const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                            const double threshold,\n                            std::vector<int>& members,\n                            std::vector<double>& maxd) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n    const int nt = hostThreads(N);\n\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        double d = DBL_MAX;\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed) {\n            d = distance(points[c], sp);\n            if (d >= threshold) d = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        maxd[c] = d;\n    }\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < N) {\n        double best_d = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_i = -1;\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n        {\n            double bd = DBL_MAX;\n            int bi = -1;\n#pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n                const double d = maxd[c];\n                if (d < threshold && d < bd) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = c;\n                }\n            }\n#pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (bi >= 0 && (best_i < 0 || bd < best_d ||\n                                (bd == best_d && bi < best_i))) {\n                    best_d = bd;\n                    best_i = bi;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_i < 0) break;\n        members.push_back(best_i);\n\n        const Point bp = points[best_i];\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            const double cur = maxd[c];\n            if (c == best_i) {\n                maxd[c] = DBL_MAX;\n            } else if (cur < DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[c], bp);\n                if (d > cur) maxd[c] = (d < threshold) ? d : DBL_MAX;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  std::vector<GpuCtx>& ctxs,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    const int G = static_cast<int>(ctxs.size());\n    std::vector<int> my_seeds;\n    my_seeds.reserve((N + nprocs - 1) / nprocs);\n    std::vector<int> cards(N);\n    std::vector<double> maxd_host(N);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Cyclic distribution of the remaining seeds across ranks\n        my_seeds.clear();\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size();\n             i += static_cast<size_t>(nprocs)) {\n            my_seeds.push_back(unclustered_indices[i]);\n        }\n        const int M = static_cast<int>(my_seeds.size());\n\n        // Grow every candidate cluster on this rank's GPUs; one OpenMP\n        // thread drives each device on a contiguous slice of the seeds.\n        long long local_best = -1;\n        if (M > 0) {\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(G) reduction(max : local_best)\n            {\n                const int t = omp_get_thread_num();\n                const int lo = static_cast<int>(\n                    static_cast<long long>(M) * t / G);\n                const int hi = static_cast<int>(\n                    static_cast<long long>(M) * (t + 1) / G);\n                const int cnt = hi - lo;\n                if (cnt > 0) {\n                    GpuCtx& g = ctxs[t];\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(g.dev));\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                          static_cast<size_t>(N),\n                                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, my_seeds.data() + lo,\n                                          static_cast<size_t>(cnt) * sizeof(int),\n                                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                    const int blocks = std::min(g.pool_blocks, cnt);\n                    candidateClusterKernel<<<blocks, KERNEL_BLOCK>>>(\n                        g.d_points, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, cnt, N,\n                        threshold, g.d_pool, g.d_cards);\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cards.data() + lo, g.d_cards,\n                                          static_cast<size_t>(cnt) * sizeof(int),\n                                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n                    for (int i = lo; i < hi; ++i) {\n                        const long long e = encodeBest(cards[i], my_seeds[i]);\n                        if (e > local_best) local_best = e;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global selection: highest cardinality, ties to the lowest seed\n        long long global_best = -1;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (global_best < 0) break;  // No more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Every rank re-grows the winning cluster deterministically on the\n        // host, so no member broadcast is needed.\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = decodeSeed(global_best);\n        growClusterHost(cluster.seed_point, clustered, points, threshold,\n                        cluster.members, maxd_host);\n\n        // Mark all members as clustered\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end());\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        const int msize = static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n        const int nt = hostThreads(msize * msize / 2);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic) reduction(max : max_diameter) \\\n    num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n        for (int i = 0; i < msize; ++i) {\n            for (int j = i + 1; j < msize; ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n Per-candidate maximum distances to the\n//    growing cluster are maintained incrementally (O(N) per added member\n//    instead of O(N * |members|)), which is exactly equivalent since\n//    max() over the same set of distances is order independent.\n//  - OpenMP: threads drive multiple GPUs per rank concurrently, and\n//    parallelize the host-side re-growth of the winning cluster as well\n//    as the statistics/serialization loops.\n//\n// Floating point contraction is disabled on both host (-ffp-contract=off)\n// and device (-fmad=false) so CPU and GPU distance computations are\n// bitwise identical, preserving the sequential algorithm's semantics.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA candidate-cluster kernel\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// One thread block grows one candidate cluster per seed (blocks stride over\n// the seed list). Every future member must lie within `threshold` of the\n// seed, so the block first compacts those neighbors into a candidate list\n// and then only ever touches that list. maxd[i] holds the maximum distance\n// from candidate cand[i] to all current cluster members; DBL_MAX marks\n// candidates that became unavailable (added to the cluster, or exceeded the\n// threshold — maxd only grows, so such a point can never be added later).\n// Each step adds the eligible candidate with the smallest maxd (ties broken\n// by the lowest point index), matching the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\nstatic const int KERNEL_BLOCK = 256;\n\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                       const int num_seeds,\n                                       const int N,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       double* __restrict__ maxd_pool,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cand_pool,\n double* maxd = maxd_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* cand = cand_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n        // Compact the seed's threshold neighborhood into the candidate list\n        // (list order is arbitrary; selection best_i = cand[i];\n                }\n            }\n            s_dist[threadIdx.x] = best_d;\n            s_idx[threadIdx.x] = best_i;\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Block-level (distance, index) lexicographic min reduction\n            for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < off) {\n                    const double od = s_dist[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    const int oi = s_idx[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    if (oi >= 0 &&\n                        (s_idx[threadIdx.x] < 0 || od < s_dist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                         (od == s_dist[threadIdx.x] && oi < s_idx[threadIdx.x]))) {\n                        s_dist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        s_idx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_best = s_idx[0];\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const int best = s_best;\n            if (best < 0) break;  // No more points can be added\n            count++;\n\n            // Incrementally fold the new member into every candidate's maxd\n            const Point bp = points[best];\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < L; i += blockDim.x) {\n                const double cur = maxd[i];\n Per-candidate maximum distances to the\n//    growing cluster are maintained incrementally (O(N) per added member\n//    instead of O(N * |members|)), which is exactly equivalent since\n//    max() over the same set of distances is order independent.\n//  - OpenMP: threads drive multiple GPUs per rank concurrently, and\n//    parallelize the host-side re-growth of the winning cluster as well\n//    as the statistics/serialization loops.\n//\n// Floating point contraction is disabled on both host (-ffp-contract=off)\n// and device (-fmad=false) so CPU and GPU distance computations are\n// bitwise identical, preserving the sequential algorithm's semantics.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                            \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                       \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA candidate-cluster kernel\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// One thread block grows one candidate cluster per seed (blocks stride over\n// the seed list). Every future member must lie within `threshold` of the\n// seed, so the block first compacts those neighbors into a candidate list\n// and then only ever touches that list. maxd[i] holds the maximum distance\n// from candidate cand[i] to all current cluster members; DBL_MAX marks\n// candidates that became unavailable (added to the cluster, or exceeded the\n// threshold — maxd only grows, so such a point can never be added later).\n// Each step adds the eligible candidate with the smallest maxd (ties broken\n// by the lowest point index), matching the sequential algorithm exactly.\n\nstatic const int KERNEL_BLOCK = 256;\n\n__global__ void candidateClusterKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                       const int num_seeds,\n                                       const int N,\n                                       const double threshold,\n                                       double* __restrict__ maxd_pool,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cand_pool,\n                                       int* __restrict__ cards) {\n    __shared__ double s_dist[KERNEL_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_idx[KERNEL_BLOCK];\n    __shared__ int s_best;\n    __shared__ int s_count;\n\n    double* maxd = maxd_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* cand = cand_pool + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        const Point sp = points[seed];\n\n        // Compact the seed's threshold neighborhood into the candidate list\n        // (list order is arbitrary; selection ties break on the point index)\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_count = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (!clustered[c] && c != seed) {\n                const double d = distance(points[c], sp);\n                if (d < threshold) {\n                    const int slot = atomicAdd(&s_count, 1);\n                    cand[slot] = c;\n                    maxd[slot] = d;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int L = s_count;\n\n        int count = 1;\n        while (count < N) {\n            // Per-thread argmin over eligible candidates\n            double best_d = DBL_MAX;\n            int best_i = -1;\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < L; i += blockDim.x) {\n                const double d = maxd[i];\n                if (d < threshold &&\n                    (d < best_d || (d == best_d && cand[i] < best_i))) {\n                    best_d = d;\n                    best_i = cand[i];\n                }\n            }\n            s_dist[threadIdx.x] = best_d;\n            s_idx[threadIdx.x] = best_i;\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            // Block-level (distance, index) lexicographic min reduction\n            for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n                if (threadIdx.x < off) {\n                    const double od = s_dist[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    const int oi = s_idx[threadIdx.x + off];\n                    if (oi >= 0 &&\n                        (s_idx[threadIdx.x] < 0 || od < s_dist[threadIdx.x] ||\n                         (od == s_dist[threadIdx.x] && oi < s_idx[threadIdx.x]))) {\n                        s_dist[threadIdx.x] = od;\n                        s_idx[threadIdx.x] = oi;\n                    }\n                }\n                __syncthreads();\n            }\n            if (threadIdx.x == 0) s_best = s_idx[0];\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const int best = s_best;\n            if (best < 0) break;  // No more points can be added\n            count++;\n\n            // Incrementally fold the new member into every candidate's maxd\n            const Point bp = points[best];\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < L; i += blockDim.x) {\n                const double cur = maxd[i];\n                if (cur < DBL_MAX) {\n                    if (cand[i] == best) {\n                        maxd[i] = DBL_MAX;\n                    } else {\n                        const double d = distance(points[cand[i]], bp);\n                        if (d > cur) maxd[i] = (d < threshold) ? d : DBL_MAX;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        cards[s] = count;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Per-GPU device context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct GpuCtx {\n    int dev = -1;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    double* d_pool = nullptr;\n    int* d_cand_pool = nullptr;\n    int pool_blocks = 0;\n};\n\nstatic void initGpuCtx(GpuCtx& g, const int dev, const std::vector<Point>& points) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    g.dev = dev;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(dev));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_points, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(Point)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_points, points.data(),\n                          static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(Point),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_clustered, static_cast<size_t>(N)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_seeds, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_cards, static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(int)));\n\n    // Size the scratch pool (one row of N doubles per resident block),\n    // capped at half of the currently free device memory.\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t row = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n    size_t cap = (free_mem / 2) / row;\n    if (cap < 1) cap = 1;\n    g.pool_blocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(1024, cap));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_pool, static_cast<size_t>(g.pool_blocks) * row));\n}\n\nstatic void freeGpuCtx(GpuCtx& g) {\n    if (g.dev < 0) return;\n    cudaSetDevice(g.dev);\n    cudaFree(g.d_points);\n    cudaFree(g.d_clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.d_cards);\n    cudaFree(g.d_pool);\n    g.dev = -1;\n}\n\n// Encode (cardinality, seed) so that MPI_MAX picks the highest cardinality,\n// with ties broken by the lowest seed index (matching the sequential scan\n// order over the ascending unclustered list).\nstatic inline long long encodeBest(const int card, const int seed) {\n    if (card < 0) return -1;\n    return (static_cast<long long>(card) << 31) |\n           static_cast<long long>(INT32_MAX - seed);\n}\n\nstatic inline int decodeSeed(const long long v) {\n    return INT32_MAX - static_cast<int>(v & 0x7FFFFFFFLL);\n}\n\n// Pick a host thread count proportional to the loop size; spawning the full\n// thread pool (e.g. 256 logical CPUs) for small arrays costs far more in\n// fork/join overhead than the loop itself.\nstatic inline int hostThreads(const int work) {\n    int t = work / 2048;\n    if (t < 1) t = 1;\n    const int m = omp_get_max_threads();\n    return t > m ? m : t;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host-side (OpenMP) re-growth of the winning candidate cluster.\n// Uses the same incremental max-distance scheme as the kernel and therefore\n// produces the identical member list, in the identical insertion order.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic void growClusterHost(const int seed,\n                            const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,\n                            const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                            const double threshold,\n                            std::vector<int>& members,\n                            std::vector<double>& maxd) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    members.clear();\n    members.push_back(seed);\n    const int nt = hostThreads(N);\n\n    const Point sp = points[seed];\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        double d = DBL_MAX;\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed) {\n            d = distance(points[c], sp);\n            if (d >= threshold) d = DBL_MAX;\n        }\n        maxd[c] = d;\n    }\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < N) {\n        double best_d = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_i = -1;\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n        {\n            double bd = DBL_MAX;\n            int bi = -1;\n#pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n                const double d = maxd[c];\n                if (d < threshold && d < bd) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = c;\n                }\n            }\n#pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (bi >= 0 && (best_i < 0 || bd < best_d ||\n                                (bd == best_d && bi < best_i))) {\n                    best_d = bd;\n                    best_i = bi;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (best_i < 0) break;\n        members.push_back(best_i);\n\n        const Point bp = points[best_i];\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            const double cur = maxd[c];\n            if (c == best_i) {\n                maxd[c] = DBL_MAX;\n            } else if (cur < DBL_MAX) {\n                const double d = distance(points[c], bp);\n                if (d > cur) maxd[c] = (d < threshold) ? d : DBL_MAX;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  std::vector<GpuCtx>& ctxs,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int nprocs) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    std::iota(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    const int G = static_cast<int>(ctxs.size());\n    std::vector<int> my_seeds;\n    my_seeds.reserve((N + nprocs - 1) / nprocs);\n    std::vector<int> cards(N);\n    std::vector<double> maxd_host(N);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Cyclic distribution of the remaining seeds across ranks\n        my_seeds.clear();\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size();\n             i += static_cast<size_t>(nprocs)) {\n            my_seeds.push_back(unclustered_indices[i]);\n        }\n        const int M = static_cast<int>(my_seeds.size());\n\n        // Grow every candidate cluster on this rank's GPUs; one OpenMP\n        // thread drives each device on a contiguous slice of the seeds.\n        long long local_best = -1;\n        if (M > 0) {\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(G) reduction(max : local_best)\n            {\n                const int t = omp_get_thread_num();\n                const int lo = static_cast<int>(\n                    static_cast<long long>(M) * t / G);\n                const int hi = static_cast<int>(\n                    static_cast<long long>(M) * (t + 1) / G);\n                const int cnt = hi - lo;\n                if (cnt > 0) {\n                    GpuCtx& g = ctxs[t];\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(g.dev));\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                          static_cast<size_t>(N),\n                                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, my_seeds.data() + lo,\n                                          static_cast<size_t>(cnt) * sizeof(int),\n                                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                    const int blocks = std::min(g.pool_blocks, cnt);\n                    candidateClusterKernel<<<blocks, KERNEL_BLOCK>>>(\n                        g.d_points, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, cnt, N,\n                        threshold, g.d_pool, g.d_cards);\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cards.data() + lo, g.d_cards,\n                                          static_cast<size_t>(cnt) * sizeof(int),\n                                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n                    for (int i = lo; i < hi; ++i) {\n                        const long long e = encodeBest(cards[i], my_seeds[i]);\n                        if (e > local_best) local_best = e;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global selection: highest cardinality, ties to the lowest seed\n        long long global_best = -1;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local_best, &global_best, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX,\n                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (global_best < 0) break;  // No more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Every rank re-grows the winning cluster deterministically on the\n        // host, so no member broadcast is needed.\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = decodeSeed(global_best);\n        growClusterHost(cluster.seed_point, clustered, points, threshold,\n                        cluster.members, maxd_host);\n\n        // Mark all members as clustered\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end());\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        const int msize = static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n        const int nt = hostThreads(msize * msize / 2);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic) reduction(max : max_diameter) \\\n    num_threads(nt) if (nt > 1)\n        for (int i = 0; i < msize; ++i) {\n            for (int j = i + 1; j < msize; ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, replicated on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Assign GPUs: ranks on the same node partition the visible devices.\n    MPI_Comm local_comm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank,\n                        MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_comm);\n    int local_rank = 0, local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(local_comm, &local_size);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&local_comm);\n\n    int ndev = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n    if (ndev <= 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Error: no CUDA devices available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    int dev_start, dev_count;\n    if (local_size >= ndev) {\n        dev_start = local_rank % ndev;\n        dev_count = 1;\n    } else {\n        const int per = ndev / local_size;\n        const int extra = ndev % local_size;\n        dev_start = local_rank * per + std::min(local_rank, extra);\n        dev_count = per + (local_rank < extra ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<GpuCtx> ctxs(dev_count);\n    for (int i = 0; i < dev_count; ++i) {\n        initGpuCtx(ctxs[i], dev_start + i, points);\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d, GPUs on rank 0: %d, OpenMP threads: %d\\n\",\n               nprocs, dev_count, omp_get_max_threads());\n    }\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters =\n        qtClustering(points, threshold, ctxs, rank, nprocs);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < dev_count; ++i) {\n        freeGpuCtx(ctxs[i]);\n    }\n\n    int exit_code = 0;\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n        // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n        int total_clustered = 0;\n        int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n            total_clustered += size;\n            max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n        }\n\n        const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n            static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                     \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA candidate-cluster kernel\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// One thread block grows one candidate cluster per seed (blocks stride over\n// the seed list). into every candidate's maxd\n            const Point bp = points[best];\n            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < L; i += blockDim.x) {\n                const double cur = maxd[i];\n Per-candidate maximum distances to the\n//    growing cluster are maintained incrementally (O(N) per added member\n//    instead of O(N * |members|)), which is exactly equivalent since\n//    max() over the same set of distances is order independent.\n//  - OpenMP: threads drive multiple GPUs per rank concurrently, and\n//    parallelize the host-side re-growth of the winning cluster as well\n//    as the statistics/serialization loops.\n//\n// Floating point contraction is disabled on both host (-ffp-contract=off)\n// and device (-fmad=false) so CPU and GPU distance computations are\n// bitwise identical, preserving the sequential algorithm's semantics.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); The qtclustering benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program with bit-identical results to the original and speedups of ~800–3000× on this machine (N=2000: 88.5s → 28ms; N=20000: extrapolated hours → 1.8s; N=50000 runs in 19s).\n\n**How it's parallelized** (all three levels are unconditional):\n- **MPI**: each outer iteration's candidate seeds are distributed cyclically across ranks; the globally best candidate cluster is chosen with an `MPI_Allreduce(MAX)` on an encoded `(cardinality, seed)` key that reproduces the sequential tie-break (highest cardinality, then lowest seed index). Ranks on a node partition the visible GPUs via a shared-memory sub-communicator, so both `mpirun -np 4` (1 GPU/rank) and a single rank (all GPUs) use the full machine.\n- **CUDA**: candidate clusters grow on the GPU, one thread block per seed, with a block-level lexicographic `(distance, index)` argmin reduction per added member.\n- **OpenMP**: threads drive multiple GPUs per rank concurrently, and parallelize the host-side re-growth of the winning cluster (every rank regrows it deterministically, so no member broadcast is needed) plus validation. Thread counts are capped proportionally to loop size — the 256-logical-CPU machine made full-width fork/join cost more than the loops themselves.\n\n**Exact-semantics algorithmic optimizations** (these, not just the hardware, provide most of the speedup):\n- Per-candidate max-distance to the cluster is maintained *incrementally* (O(N) per added member instead of O(N·|members|)); `max` over the same set of doubles is order-independent, so results are identical.\n- Since max-distance only grows, a candidate that reaches the threshold is permanently excluded, and every future member must lie within the threshold of the seed — so each block compacts the seed's neighborhood once and only scans that short list thereafter.\n- FP contraction is disabled on both host (`-ffp-contract=off`) and device (`-fmad=false`) so CPU and GPU distances are bitwise identical, keeping GPU-selected cardinalities consistent with the host re-growth.\n\n**Verification**: membership hashes match the original sequential binary exactly for N=500/1000/2000 (and t=0.1 singleton case), are identical across 1/2/3/4 MPI ranks up to N=50000, and `-v` validation passes everywhere. Edge cases (help, invalid args, huge threshold → 1 cluster) behave as before; N=1 hangs in data generation, but that's a pre-existing behavior of the original generator, not a regression.\n\n**CMake**: the single source is compiled as CUDA (`set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`), links MPI/OpenMP/cudart via the host C++ linker, and uses native GPU architecture detection. Executable name and file set are unchanged."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":292,"cache_read_input_tokens":77035,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":292},"output_tokens":731,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d5bc3dcc-411c-419d-8347-8ba48fee2c4f","uuid":"3ffdce4a-f02f-4a97-80a2-c74cfca25637","timestamp":"2026-09-12T17:06:00.997Z","request_id":"req_011Ceyujc3z41LiVNN61dkpx"}
